name: customs-web
//: typescript stays on 6.0: TypeScript 7 (the native Go compiler) exports no stable JS API, and typescript-eslint, which `npm run lint` needs, supports typescript <6.1.0 in its latest and canary releases. Move to 7 once typescript-eslint does.
@types/node tracks the Node major in .nvmrc (24); @playwright/test is pinned exactly so the browser build `npx playwright install` fetches matches the test runner.
The lockfile's one pre-release, gensync 1.0.0-beta.2 (pulled in by @babel/core under eslint-plugin-react-hooks, lint only), is that package's latest release; no stable 1.x exists.
